showNotes: George's answer to “what bothers you most about the legal profession?” takes one word: mediocrity. Lawyers mailing it in, from the solo down the street to the AmLaw 50 firm that still gets the client's name wrong in the deal documents.

Jordan and George get into where it comes from: “File > Save As” and the copy-paste habit (and the pleading Jordan never forgot), a billable-hour model that pays for time instead of results, a bar so low that returning a phone call puts you in the top 10%, and what AI does to all of it when it's treated like a slot machine.

Then the practical part: what young lawyers who want more than mediocrity can do about it, how clients can tell when they're getting mailed-in work, why “it depends” is only the start of an answer, and how to use AI to check your lawyer without running up your bill.
